title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent call recaps for call queue calls in the Queues app
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing requirements and documented controls are supported. One minor correction is needed to acknowledge conflicting Microsoft pages about mobile support for the Queues app. Queue-recap defaults, access rules and feature-specific licensing remain undocumented in the sources checked.

claims.claim: Recording template creation is reached in Teams admin center through Voice > Templates and resources > Templates > Automatic Recording > Add > Call recording.

claims.claim: New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate -RecordingEnabled $true -TranscriptionEnabled $true creates a template with recording and transcription enabled.
claims.quote: [-TranscriptionEnabled <Boolean>] [-RecordingEnabled <Boolean>] ... This example creates a new Auto Recording template that enabled transcription and recording.

claims.claim: The automatic recording template controls whether inbound queue calls are recorded.
claims.quote: This article is for IT pros and Teams administrators who want to configure automatic recording and transcription for inbound call queue calls. ... Call recording is enabled by default. Disable call recording if required.

claims.claim: Transcription can be configured in the same template immediately after call recording.
claims.quote: 7. Call recording is enabled by default. Disable call recording if required. 8. Transcription is enabled by default. Disable transcription if required.
